VI.description: The status of every RemoteVI share of this LabVIEW application instance (RemoteVI Start.vi\2C the Tools menu entry or RemoteVI Server)\2C for your own UI or a log. Per share\3A port\2C url (the full link with its access token)\2C target (the VI or window shared) and kind (VI or Window)\2C whole network (FALSE\3A this computer only)\2C running (the server loop updated it within the last 2 s)\2C uptime s\2C the clients with their address\2C connected s and idle s (seconds since their last input\2C -1 when none yet)\2C fps (frames made per second)\2C kB per s sent\2C frames made\2C latency ms (last remote click or key to the next frame)\2C view only and last error. text is the same as readable text (RemoteVI Status Text.vi). The server loops publish every 500 ms\3B this VI only reads\2C so it is cheap to call in a loop. RemoteVI Status Panel.vi shows it.

Indicator.type: array{cluster{uint16.port,string.url,string.target,string.kind,bool.whole network,bool.running,double.uptime s,array{cluster{string.address,double.connected s,double.idle s}}.clients,double.fps,double.kB per s,uint32.frames,double.latency ms,bool.view only,string.last error}}

Indicator.description: The status as readable text\2C one block per share.
